title: Whippoorwill Campground

services.name: Campsite
services.desc: Lock-in your favorite site for a $25 site lock-in fee. this guarantees a specific site for your stay. Otherwise, your site number is not guaranteed and may change prior to arrival. Whether you pitch a tent or bring your camper, we have standard sites with W/E & RV sites W/E/S! Parking for two vehicles, with extra parking available for free in the main parking

services.name: Cabin stay
services.desc: No camper? No problem! Book a stay in one of our waterless rustic cabins, located directly next to the main bathhouse! Two pet friendly cabins, each sleep 5 guests with one double/single bunk and one single/single bunk. Four other standard cabins, each sleep 6 guests with two double/single bunks. Each site has parking for one vehicle, with extra parking available for free in the main parking lot. 2 adults and 2 children are included with your stay. Guest fees include overnight stay and access to all facilities, including the pool. No on under the age of 21 is allowed unless accompanied by a legal guardian. Please review all policies prior to arrival for more information about pets,
